title: Examples / Collateral

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Place acknowledgement where it supports the document’s message so readers can distinguish publisher from partner across one or more sides.
strategic_value: A consistent division between partner ownership and IBM contribution can carry through printed collateral.
demonstration: A one-sided layout is compared with overlapping front/back layouts; green partner branding leads while smaller IBM attribution sits within content.
practical_value: Decide whether the IBM acknowledgement belongs on the primary face or a supporting content face without changing who owns the piece.

content_islands.name: One-sided collateral
content_islands.spec: Place the single tall layout at left with partner mark at top and a smaller IBM mark among the text elements.

content_islands.name: Two-sided collateral
content_islands.spec: Place the overlapping front and back layouts at right, with relationship copy near IBM on the rear face.

content_islands.name: Example status
content_islands.spec: Keep the nonexclusive-layout note below the comparison.

reference_purposes.Application: The page demonstrates partner and IBM placement across one-sided and two-sided collateral.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says the layout options are not restricted to the examples shown.
